title: Type system (language view)
summary: C# is strongly typed at compile time. This module covers declared types and var inference, built-in numeric and text types, value versus reference semantics, default values and definite assignment, null and nullable value types, conversions and type tests, the catalog of custom type kinds, and object, the Common Type System (CTS), and dynamic late binding.

topics.title: Value types vs reference types (copy vs alias)
Default values and definite assignment (locals vs fields)
null and nullable values (missing data for structs)
Type conversions and tests (is, as, typeof)
Custom type kinds (class, struct, record, and more)
object, Common Type System, and dynamic (late binding)
